checks: The binding header names the decision version, build hash and acceptance map version rather than 'latest'.
Cohort 1 is restricted to one workspace so a cross-workspace failure is visible before wider exposure.
Every observation has a source, a baseline and a stop threshold; the cross-workspace draft count stops on any occurrence.
The rollback cites validation:V-88 as its drill receipt at the plan's build hash.
Every alert and rollback step has a named owner and a backup; no owner is a team name.
Enabling the production flag is marked human_required and appears in requested_followups as a human action request, not as an agent task.
The send-automatically conflict is recorded under Open conflicts and routed to W11, and the plan implements the drafts-only policy.
